# Optics · Photonics

> Independent optical and photonic research software: native programs, background calculations, simulation sessions, MCP, Skills and Agent plugins.

Choose a research task, then its computing host. The task catalogue groups open-source modules by research area and direction. The wider reference covers 110 software families, including optional commercial connections.

## Start a task

- [Start here](https://github.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/blob/main/skills/optical-computation/references/start.md): choose an open-source task module and the computing host. Commercial applications are optional external connections, not default installations.
- [Computation guide](https://github.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/blob/main/skills/optical-computation/SKILL.md): choose an environment, run a calculation, inspect results and continue saved work; detailed topics load on demand.
- [Research guide](https://github.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/blob/main/skills/optical-research/SKILL.md): frame the physical question, choose a method and interpret the calculation.
- [Independent integrations](https://github.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/blob/main/skills/optical-computation/references/integrations.md): add software, programs and guides in separately maintained packages.

## Foundations

- [Field · Matter · Interaction](https://cherish0925.github.io/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/foundations.html): unified physical framework across classical and quantum optics.
- [场 · 物质 · 相互作用](https://cherish0925.github.io/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/foundations.zh.html): 中文统一物理基础。
- [Foundation Markdown](https://github.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/blob/main/foundations/README.md): maintainable English source.

## Read

- [Complete English catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/main/llms-full.txt): all entries, interfaces, limits and sources.
- [中文完整目录](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/main/docs/catalogue.zh.md): Chinese equivalent.
- [English interactive catalogue](https://cherish0925.github.io/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/catalogue.html): models, workflows, examples and resource search.
- [中文交互目录](https://cherish0925.github.io/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/catalogue.zh.html): full Chinese catalogue.

## Integrate

- [Install and connect](https://github.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/blob/main/docs/CONNECT.md): native programs, MCP, Skills and independent background calculations.
- [Connection data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/main/data/connections.json): all catalogue IDs with execution routes and upstream sources.
- [Research connections](https://cherish0925.github.io/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/connect.html): interactive installation and coverage guide.

- [English JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/main/data/catalogue.en.json): complete structured entries.
- [中文 JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/main/data/catalogue.zh.json): same IDs and source URLs.
- [Resource index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/main/data/resources.en.json): documentation, code, licenses and connector URLs linked to software IDs.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/EnvFoundry/Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): source and update conventions.

## Interpretation

Start from the physical task and representation, then filter by licensing, compute and native interfaces. Follow primary sources for current installation and API details. Each entry records the scope of MCP and Skills, their provenance status, and the software license. Execute through the linked native interfaces in the required environment.
